thread:
SRE Oncall Bot: INCIDENT ALERT — hosted-api-prod: sudden spike in 5xx rate > 2% for last 2m, paging SRE oncall @here :rotating_light:
Jess (oncall): seeing it, jumping in. grabbing logs and traffic shard info.
Omar R: I can grab the API gateway logs and check for recent deploys. no deploys in last 24h per deploy-bot.
Kevin L: ETA to triage? is customer impact visible?
Jess (oncall): not yet clear on customer impact, but frontend retries increased. adding temporary 5xx spike dashboard panel in dev workspace.
Maya P: adding myself for customer impact triage — checking support queue for correlated complaints.
Jess (oncall): root cause hunt: initial check: error body shows downstream timeouts to model inference service (dedicated pool). suspect saturation or network flaps.
Omar R: querying metrics: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="infer",code=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="infer"}[1m]))` shows 5xx ratio spike aligned with paging. GPU mem and driver metrics look ok.
Kevin L: maybe KV cache eviction storm? that would increase cold-start latencies. any cache hit rate drops?
Jess (oncall): checking cache metrics: hit rate for kv-cache dropped from 98% to 60% around 15:02 UTC. also see backlog queue length rising for worker pool w=infra-infer-1.
SRE Oncall Bot: Note — next on-call rotation @ 16:00 UTC. Handoff reminder will be posted at 15:50 UTC.
Omar R: can we throttle traffic to the dedicated pool and route overflow to hosted fallback model variant? we have routing policy ready.
Jess (oncall): good call. applying routing rule `route: if(p95_latency>200ms, fallback=hosted-small)` to the sharded policy for that customer group. code snippet:
```
policy: shard-route
condition: p95_latency>200
action: route_to=hosted-small, weight=0.6
```
Jess (oncall): applied, watching for error rate.
Maya P: support reports 3 customers with elevated errors; pinged them with status update. I'll note impact in incident doc.
Kevin L: error rate back to 0.4% after routing change. latency p95 improved from 420ms -> 180ms. nice.
Omar R: still seeing periodic tiny spikes in backlog. I think alert thresholds are too sensitive—we're getting noise from transient kv-cache dropouts.
Jess (oncall): agreed. open action: tune pager thresholds to reduce noise: raise 5xx ratio alert from 1% sustained 1m to 2% sustained 2m for that shard. also add an alert for backlog queue length > 100 for 1m.
Kevin L: also let's add a golden-signals retrospective dashboard — include panels: global 5xx ratio, p50/p95 latencies, worker queue length, kv-cache hit-rate, GPU utilization, routing fallback rate. drilldown links to traces and request logs.
Maya P: I'll create the initial dashboard in Grafana and share link. We'll use the retro dashboard for post-incident review and to tune alerts.
Jess (oncall): adding quick queries for dashboard panels:
- 5xx ratio panel (PromQL): `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"infer|gateway",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"infer|gateway"}[5m]))`
- p95 latency (histogram): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="infer"}[5m])) by (le))`
- kv-cache hit rate: `sum(cache_hits) / sum(cache_requests)`
- backlog queue length: `sum(queue_length{worker_pool="infra-infer-1"})`
Include drilldowns: panel links should pass variables `?var_shard=infra-infer-1&from=-1h`.
Omar R: for drilldowns, add a panel that opens Jaeger traces filtered by `service=infer & error=true`. saves time in triage.
Maya P: created dashboard draft: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd1234/retro-infer-spike (sharing). panels added: 5xx ratio, p95, queue length, kv-hit, gpu-util, fallback-rate, recent deploys, and support ticket count.
Jess (oncall): looks good. proposed alert changes (to be implemented after incident stabilization):
- `High5xxRatio_infer_shard`: when 5xx_ratio > 2% for 2m -> page SRE
- `BacklogHigh_infer_pool`: when queue_length > 100 for 1m -> page SRE
- `KVCacheDrop_warning`: when kv_cache_hit < 70% for 1m -> warn slack channel (no page)
Kevin L: agree to those. add runbook link to each alert to speed mitigation.
Maya P: I'll schedule a retro session tomorrow 10:00 and put action items in the incident doc: 1) implement alert changes 2) make routing fallback test plan 3) automate dashboard creation for future similar incidents.
Jess (oncall): final status: incident mitigated, routing fallback engaged, error rate back to baseline. marking as resolved but keeping postmortem open.
Product Ops Bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026 created and linked.
Jess (oncall): thanks everyone. follow-ups assigned: Omar -> investigate root cause of kv-cache eviction drop; Kevin -> add runbook steps and alerts in prometheus; Maya -> finalize Grafana retro dashboard + retro meeting invite. I'll start the post-incident doc. :white_check_mark:
